relevance.justification: GENEasso is a gene-disease association database directly in the BioThings sphere. Primary entities are genes (Ensembl IDs, HGNC symbols) and diseases (EFO/MONDO/MeSH ontology terms), with GWAS-derived statistical associations as the relationship payload. Maps to core BioThings entity types: gene (MyGene.info), disease (MyDisease.info), and gene-disease associations (pending.api). The data is annotation-dense: per-association P-values, Z-scores, Beta, method, tissue, population, and genomic coordinates.

novelty.justification: No existing BioThings API provides GWAS-derived gene-based disease associations with multi-method consensus scoring. MyGene.info lacks gene-disease associations entirely. MyDisease.info includes DisGeNET and CTD but these are curated literature/variant-level databases, not GWAS gene-based. DisGeNET has gene-disease relationships but not computed from GWAS summary statistics using 7 quantitative methods (MAGMA, DEPICT, PASCAL, CWAS, RWAS, LDAK-GBAT, SMR variants). The ancestry stratification (AFR/AMR/EAS/EUR/SAS from 1KGP super-populations) and cross-method consensus scoring are unique. GENEasso's 716,122 associations across 8,226 GWAS datasets is a scale not represented in any pending.api source.

openness.justification: All data freely downloadable without login or registration. Per-method bulk download files (TSV) accessible via https://www.geneasso.net/api/download/static/{METHOD}.download.txt — all return HTTP 200 with Content-Type: application/octet-stream, no authentication headers required. License text on site states: 'GENEasso is available free of charge for all users, including both academic and commercial users.' Paper states: 'full transparency and unrestricted access to data.' PMC open access (PMCID: PMC12807607). Oxford University Press NAR database issue publication.
